title: Affine complements on an integral one-dimensional scheme admit globally generated principal opens
statement: Let $X$ be an integral [def-pc-integral-scheme] separated [def-weil-proper-morphism] Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth] [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme] scheme [def-pc-scheme] of topological Krull dimension $1$ [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension], and let $U$ be a nonempty affine open subscheme such that $X\setminus U$ is a finite set of points. Then there exist an invertible [def-sc-invertible-module] $\mathcal O_X$-module $\mathcal L$ generated by global sections [def-weil-pbc-generating-sections] and a global section $s$ such that, for the open $X_s$ defined in [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module], $X_s=U$.

proof.text: Apply the reciprocal-cover lemma to obtain V,f,g with U union V = X, fg = 1 on the overlap, and D(g) = U intersect V.
Apply the reciprocal-cover line-bundle construction to obtain invertible L and compatible global sections s,t with X_s = U and V contained in X_t.

Form the family indexed by ULift (Fin 2) selecting s at 0 and t at 1. Every point belongs to U or V, hence to the nonvanishing locus of one of these two sections. The invertible generating-sections fibre criterion makes the associated free-module map an epimorphism. Its index type and section family therefore give GeneratingSections L. Return L and the value of s at the terminal open.
